newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks firmer on blue chip buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks firmer on blue chip buying.

text.p: Jakarta stocks were firmer at midsession on the back of limited buying in blue chips coupled with active buying in small-capitalised stocks, brokers said.
At lunchbreak, the Jakarta Composite Index was 5.52 points or 0.78 percent higher at 717.75 points. Gainers led losers by 58 to 51, with 65 counters unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 215 billion rupiah.
Brokers expected the index to hover at the level of 710-720 points in the afternoon on further buying in blue chip stocks.

Blue chips Citra Marga and Telkom were likely to get continued attention in the afternoon, brokers said, adding that Citra Marga's plan of one-for-one rights issue at 500 rupiah each seemed to boost sentiment on the counter.
"Local investors are likely to continue snapping up small stocks, some of them on rumours of possible stock splits," a broker with major local firm said.
He said companies which planned to pay dividends and had reported encouraging first quarter net profits were also likely to become targets of buyers.
Small garment firm Karwell topped the active list with 10 million shares changing hands, rising 75 rupiah to 1,200 rupiah on speculation of a stock split, brokers said.
Property companies Jababeka JIKA.JK and Duta Anggada attracted market attention following their strong net profits in the first quarter, brokers said.
